name: solid element
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 用于离散三维连续体的有限元单元。
usage_overview: 实体单元用于将土体、轮对等三维连续体离散为有限元模型，以描述其空间变形，服务于车辆—轨道相互作用中近场土体响应及轮对柔性的分析。

complete_examples.text: In Figure 7 (b), the predictions by applying solid element for sleepers are compared with those from rigid-body element.
With almost the same law, the wheel-rail forces of the elastic-beam and solid element models are almost the same but relatively larger than that of the rigid-body element model.

In this work the rail pad is modeled as a spring-dashpot element, and the railway ballast is modeled as mass-spring-damper element; for the other bodies, the rail and the subgrade are modeled as Timoshenko (or Bernoulli-Euler) beam-columns and solid element respectively, as shown in Fig. 2 .
In the modelling process, the solid element is applied to model the sleeper.
ABAQUS commercial finite element software is taken as an example to establish the finite element model of flexible wheelset with eight-node solid element.
